notes: v191: Smoother play — each game day takes about half the work it did (map borders are redrawn only when they change, panels no longer force the page to re-measure itself on every update, annexed-land lookups are cached), so the game no longer stutters on each tick. Voices: no more pause after "Mr."/"Mrs."/"Dr." or inside numbers; HD voices start sooner (long sentences are spoken in clause-sized pieces) and any line a leader or ATLAS has said before plays instantly, even after a restart.
